crossRefs.note: They went into Capernaum, and immediately on the Sabbath day he entered into the synagogue and taught.
They watched him, whether he would heal him on the Sabbath day, that they might accuse him.
When evening came, they brought to him many possessed with demons. He cast out the spirits with a word, and healed all…
When the sun was setting, all those who had any sick with various diseases brought them to him; and he laid his hands…

translations.web: At evening, when the sun had set, they brought to him all who were sick, and those who were possessed by demons.
translations.bsb: That evening, after sunset, people brought to Jesus all the sick and demon-possessed,
translations.kjv: And at even, when the sun did set, they brought unto him all that were diseased, and them that were possessed with devils.
translations.asv: And at even, when the sun did set, they brought unto him all that were sick, and them that were possessed with demons.
